ExportList.Name: Export Reminder list
ExportList.Label: Export Reminder list
ExportList.Hint: Downloads this world's Reminder list (every kind of reminder) as a JSON file. Add or remove entries by right-clicking an item (Items sidebar, compendiums, actor sheets).

ImportList.Name: Import Reminder list
ImportList.Label: Import Reminder list
ImportList.Hint: Replaces this world's Reminder list with a JSON file made with Export. This can't be undone, so export the current list first if you may want it back.

LegendaryReminders.Name: Legendary action reminders
LegendaryReminders.Hint: After a player character's turn, list every NPC in combat that still has legendary action points, with its legendary actions and their cost.

AfterPcOnly.Name: Only after player characters' turns
AfterPcOnly.Hint: Post the legendary / villain card only after a player character's turn. Turn off to post it after any creature's turn (the creature whose turn just ended is left out).

VillainReminders.Name: Villain action reminders
VillainReminders.Hint: Include villain actions on the card. Each can be used once per combat; used ones are left out of later cards. The module doesn't spend legendary points for them.

ResistanceReminders.Name: Legendary resistance reminders
ResistanceReminders.Hint: Whisper the GM when a creature fails a saving throw and still has legendary resistance left, with a button to spend one.

LairReminders.Name: Lair action reminders
LairReminders.Hint: Post a card with the creature's lair actions when the turn order passes its lair initiative count (20 by default, 2014 rules).

HitReminders.Name: When-hit reminders
HitReminders.Hint: In dnd5e, whisper the GM when an attack roll hits a creature that has a when-hit trait or reaction (Heated Body, Parry, Rust Metal...), with its effect. Most trigger on melee hits only. Needs the attacker to target the creature so the roll is checked against its AC.

DeathReminders.Name: Death trigger reminders
DeathReminders.Hint: Whisper the GM when a creature with a death-triggered feature (Undead Fortitude, Death Burst, Relentless Endurance...) drops to 0 HP, with a button to use it. Works in any system. Waits while the old Death Trigger Alerts module is still on.

DeathOthers.Name: Death triggers of other creatures
DeathOthers.Hint: When a creature drops to 0 HP, also remind about other creatures' death triggers: the killer's (Great Weapon Master, Dark One's Blessing), the caster of a mark on it (Hunter's Mark, Hex), a companion's owner, and creatures in range (Keeper of Souls). These include player characters' features.

MythicReminders.Name: Mythic action reminders
MythicReminders.Hint: When a creature with mythic actions drops to 0 HP, remind about its mythic trait. Once the trait has triggered (it comes back above 0 HP, or you press Mythic trait used), its mythic actions are added to the legendary action card for the rest of the combat.

TurnReminders.Name: Start and end of turn traits
TurnReminders.Hint: At the start (or end) of a creature's turn, remind about its turn traits: Regeneration (noting acid, fire or radiant damage taken since its last turn), Berserk at low HP, the hydra's Multiple Heads.

AuraReminders.Name: Aura reminders
AuraReminders.Hint: When a creature starts its turn within range of another creature's aura (Stench), remind about it. Needs both tokens on the current scene.

RechargeReminders.Name: Recharge reminders
RechargeReminders.Hint: In dnd5e, at the start of a creature's turn, list its recharge abilities (Breath Weapon) and whether they are ready, with a button to roll the recharge.

BloodiedReminders.Name: Bloodied reminders
BloodiedReminders.Hint: When a creature drops to half its HP or less, remind about its traits for that: list entries, and features whose description says what changes while it is Bloodied (2024 stat blocks).

DamageReminders.Name: Damage reminders
DamageReminders.Hint: In dnd5e, when damage is applied, remind about traits that react to it: Lightning Absorption and Split by damage type, Swallow when the damage in one turn reaches its threshold.

SaveReminders.Name: Saving throw reminders
SaveReminders.Hint: In dnd5e, when a creature is about to roll a saving throw, remind about traits that change it (Magic Resistance, Evasion, Turn Resistance), while the roll dialog is still open.

SpellReminders.Name: Spell reaction reminders
SpellReminders.Hint: In dnd5e, when a creature casts a spell, remind about the reactions of opposing creatures in range (Counterspell).

HpPath.Name: HP attribute path
HpPath.Hint: Path inside actor.system to the current HP value that the death trigger check watches, e.g. attributes.hp.value. Leave empty to use the game system's primary token bar attribute (dnd5e: attributes.hp.value).

DetectByActivation.Name: Also detect by activation type
DetectByActivation.Hint: In dnd5e, count every item whose activation is a legendary or lair action, even if its name isn't in the Reminder list.

MergeDefaultList.Name: Add new actions from the default list
MergeDefaultList.Hint: When the world starts, add actions that are new in the module's default Reminder list (after a module update) to this world's list. Actions you removed are not added back, and your own changes are kept.

IgnorePlayerOwned.Name: Only check non-player creatures
IgnorePlayerOwned.Hint: Skip actors that have a player owner (player characters, companions).

WhisperGM.Name: Whisper to the GM only
WhisperGM.Hint: Whisper reminder cards to the GM. Turn off to post them for everyone (only the GM can press the buttons).

DeletePrevious.Name: Remove old reminder cards
DeletePrevious.Hint: When a new legendary or lair card is posted, delete the previous one of the same combat so only the current one stays in chat.

Sound.Name: Reminder sound
Sound.Hint: Sound played for the GM when a reminder card is posted. Leave empty for no sound.

DeathSound.Name: Death trigger sound
DeathSound.Hint: Sound played for the GM when a death trigger card is posted (the other cards use the reminder sound). Leave empty for no sound.
